Escalation mail service:

note.description: This service is sending notification email to initiator(Hub or branch) and cad team

tw.local.msgBody = '' + '' + '' + '' + '' + '' + '' + '
' + '

' + 'Please be informed that the Remittance Letter for ' + '' + tw.local.odcRequest.BasicDetails.requestType + ' ' + '(Request No. ' + tw.local.odcRequest.appInfo.instanceID + ') ' + 'related to the customer ' + tw.local.odcRequest.CustomerInfo.customerName + ' ' + 'is now ready for printing.' + '
